name: LoveSpark Breathe
summary: Breathing exercises, grounding techniques, and comment dimming — emotional regulation for ADHD brains.
description:
LoveSpark Breathe gives you instant access to calming tools right in your browser toolbar. Three core features to help you regulate when things get overwhelming.

Breathing Exercises
- Box Breathing (4-4-4-4)
- 4-7-8 Breathing
- Physiological Sigh (double inhale, long exhale)
- Animated visual guide with cycle tracking
- Keyboard shortcut: Alt+B

5-4-3-2-1 Grounding
- Guided sensory grounding exercise
- Step-by-step progress with visual dots
- Tap-to-advance at your own pace

Comment Dimmer
- Dims comment sections on Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram
- Manual toggle or always-on mode
- Reduces emotional triggers while browsing

Designed for ADHD and neurodivergent brains — quick access, zero overwhelm, gentle encouragement from Sparky the mascot.

Extra touches:
- 4 cozy themes (Retro Pink, Dark, Beige, Slate)
- Daily session log with encouraging messages
- Full keyboard and screen reader support
- Respects prefers-reduced-motion
- No account required — everything stays in your browser

Privacy first: No data collection, no tracking, no ads. 100% local storage. Always free, always open source.

Part of the LoveSpark suite — retro pink productivity tools for neurodivergent coders.
single_purpose: REVIEW: state the single purpose of LoveSpark Breathe in one sentence.

permission_justifications.storage: The LoveSpark Breathe extension requests the storage permission solely to save its settings and state on the user's own device using chrome.storage.local. Nothing stored under this permission ever leaves the device.
permission_justifications.activeTab: The activeTab permission lets LoveSpark Breathe act on the tab the user is currently viewing, and only when they explicitly invoke the extension. It grants no standing access to other tabs or to browsing history.
permission_justifications.tabs: The tabs permission lets LoveSpark Breathe read the active tab's URL and title so it can apply its feature to the current page. It is not used to track browsing across tabs or to build any history, and no tab data is transmitted off the device.

host_permission_justification: LoveSpark Breathe runs a content script on *://*.twitter.com/*, *://*.x.com/*, *://*.reddit.com/*, *://*.facebook.com/*, *://*.youtube.com/*, *://*.instagram.com/* to deliver its core on-page feature. REVIEW: name the specific feature. It reads only what that feature needs and transmits nothing off the device.
